name: Soul Trap (Orphaned Bookworm Productions)
body:
School necromancy; Level death mage 3, medium 3, occultist 3, psychic 3, sorcerer/wizard 3, spiritualist 3, witch 3
Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (A crystal or gem worth at least 50 gp per CR of the creature)
Range close (25 ft. + 5ft./2 levels)
Target 1 creature with a soul
Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance yes

With a wave of your hand you attempt to bind a creature’s soul to a gem or crystal. The target’s soul is tied to the material component crystal or gem. If the target should die during the duration of the spell, their soul is pulled and absorbed into the crystal creating a soul stone. Such a creature cannot be raised from the dead except for by the spell wish. For uses and stats of these soul stones, see the sidebar to the right. The soul is bound to the crystal permanently until used, dispelled or destroyed.

If the creature is killed by a spell or effect that obliterates the soul, their soul is not trapped within the soul stone and the spell fails.

If the creature does not have a soul, like most constructs, automatons or mindless undead, this spell has no effect. Additionally, this spell has no effect on summoned creatures as their souls are already tethered to their original plane by the summoning magic.
